## Simple boxes 1

::: {.value-box .bg-amber style="font-size: 1.25rem;"}

**Value boxes**

A simple value box can help convey points...

:::

Or display a metric

::: {.value-box value=60 icon="bi-arrow-down-up" icon-type="bi"}
Number of bibbles bobbled this week
:::

## Simple boxes 2

Or display a metric with an icon

::: {.value-box value=60}
Number of bibbles bobbled this week
:::

::: {.value-box .bg-amber style="font-size: 1.25rem;" fragment="true"}

**Value boxes**

And they work nicely with fragments too

:::


## Fragment types

::: {.value-box icon="bi-arrow-down-up" color="bg-blue" width="60%" align="center"}
We can use them without fragments
:::

::: {.value-box value="Big text" icon="bi-arrow-down-up" color="bg-olive" width="60%" align="center" fragment="fade-in-then-out"}
Or special named fragment types like 'fade in, then out'
:::

::: {.value-box value="Big text" icon="bi-arrow-down-up" color="bg-olive" width="60%" align="center" fragment="true"}
Or standard fragments
:::

::: {.value-box value="Big text" icon="bi-arrow-down-up" color="bg-olive" width="60%" align="center"}
That disappear when you move on.
:::




## Complex icon box layouts with index parameter

:::: {.columns}

### Right Column
